definition: Diversity training is a workplace training approach used to help promote a more inclusive organizational culture. In this context, it is presented as part of culturally sensitive support within organizations.

reasons: The first sentence is broadly supported by the packet, but the second sentence adds an unsupported interpretation: the packet does not say diversity training is itself “part of culturally sensitive support within organizations.”
The definition goes beyond the packet by generalizing from a managerial implication in one article to a broader workplace-training definition without clear support for that broader sense.

The packet supports that “diversity training” is linked to promoting inclusive workplace cultures, but it does not provide support for framing diversity training specifically as a “workplace training approach” (as opposed to a general managerial implication).

The definition’s claim that it is “part of culturally sensitive support within organizations” is only indirectly supported by the packet’s mention of “culturally sensitive policies to support migrant integration”; it does not clearly tie those culturally sensitive policies to diversity training itself.
